dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: trailing edge features a sharp vertical discontinuity at the distal terminus followed by a concave spline curving toward the posterior insertion
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: apex is truncated by a deep rectangular notch, creating a flat top with a rounded anterior corner and a sharp 90-degree posterior vertex
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: steep anterior margin measured at approximately 65-70 degrees relative to the dorsal ridge
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: approximately 1.1:1 maximum base width to vertical height ratio

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: smooth parabolic convexity of the anterior-dorsal cranial region visible above the blowhole

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: major rectangular excision at the dorsal fin apex; distinct parallel linear rake marks on the posterior dorsal peduncle; multiple small circular depigmented lesions on the mid-lateral flank
other_distinctive_markers: The specific 'step-down' morphology of the dorsal fin apex is a highly unique structural marker.
